question: What will Hon Hai (Foxconn) report as net profit attributable to owners of the parent for Q3 2026 (in NT$ billions)?

calls.reasoning: Q3 revenue known at NT$3,026.9bn. Net margins over last 4 quarters 2.36-2.80% imply ~72-85bn. FII (84%-owned) Q3 net RMB16.63bn, +26.5% QoQ from 13.15bn, implies FII-attributable ~NT$61-64bn (vs ~49bn in Q2); residual Hon Hai parent profit ran ~10-20bn in recent quarters depending on non-operating/FX items; TWD roughly flat over Q3 (-0.05%) so non-op likely better than Q2's ~0 but no big gain. Bottom-up OM 3.6-3.8%, tax 24-26%, NCI 14-15% gives ~73-83. Local analyst post-revenue range 72-86. Median ~78. Market check: harness found nothing on Polymarket/Manifold; I did not separately search Kalshi or bookmakers, and no market was found.
calls.dossier:
- Q3 2026 unaudited revenue NT$3,026.9bn, +20.44% QoQ, +47.12% YoY; Sept NT$1,158.6bn record (Hon Hai release 2026-10-05; cnyes/chinatimes 2026-10-05). Beat LSEG SmartEstimate NT$2.83tn (Reuters/Yahoo).
- Prior quarters, parent net (NT$m): Q3'25 57,673 (net margin 2.80%, non-op +16,357); Q1'26 49,919 (2.36%); Q2'26 59,974 (2.37%, non-op only +63 due to FX losses, ETR 26.2%, NCI 10,082 = 14.4% of consolidated NPAT) (question background).
- Subsidiary FII (601138, ~84% owned by Hon Hai): Q3'26 net attributable RMB16.634bn (+60.35% YoY, +26.5% QoQ vs Q2 RMB13.146bn); Q3 revenue RMB383.55bn +57.73% YoY; ex-items net RMB16.465bn (eastmoney/jrj 2026-10-29). Q3'25 FII net ~RMB10.37bn.
- Implied FII contribution to Hon Hai parent at ~4.4-4.6 TWD/RMB: Q3'26 ~NT$61-64bn vs Q2'26 ~NT$49-50bn; residual non-FII parent profit was ~NT$10bn in Q2'26 and ~NT$20bn in Q3'25 (when non-op was +16bn).
- TWD/USD: Q3 2026 change -0.05% (end-Jun to end-Sep), YTD 9M depreciation ~4.1 jiao, largest in 5 years; TWD hit a 3-month low in early July on dividend outflows (Yahoo/UDN, Oct 2026). A sharp TWD depreciation toward 33 came in late Oct, which is Q4 and irrelevant to Q3.
- Local analyst models after the revenue release: Q3 EPS ~NT$5.10-6.11 => parent net ~72-86bn depending on GM 6.12-6.35%, OM 3.76-3.8%, FX, NCI share (question background).
- FactSet 2026 full-year EPS median ~17.9 (range 16.4-20.3) per sinotrade/cnyes; H1 EPS 7.84 implies H2 ~10.1 (survey may predate the Q3 revenue beat). Share count ~13.9bn (EPS 4.27 ~ 59.97bn).
- Company said in Sept that Q3 would beat market expectations (ANI 2026-09-06); expected high-double-digit QoQ AI rack shipment growth.
- Bottom-up: OM 3.6-3.8% => OP ~109-115bn; non-op range 0 to +16bn; tax 24-26%; NCI 14-16%.
- Status quo/anchor: Q2 net margin 2.37% x Q3 revenue = ~71.8bn; Q3'25 margin 2.80% x revenue = ~84.8bn.
- Resolves off the 'Profit Attributable to Owner of the Parent' line in the Hon_Hai_3Q26 results deck (NT$m/1000), not consolidated NPAT incl. NCI. Event: results published 2026-11-12; quarter Jul 1-Sep 30 2026 already ended, so 100% of the earnings period has elapsed and only disclosure remains.
- Searched but not found: published Q3 net-profit consensus (LSEG/FactSet quarterly); Hon Hai Q3 FX hedging detail; any prediction market (none on Polymarket/Manifold per harness; Kalshi/bookmakers not checked).

calls.reasoning: Sum of parts: FII Q3 2026 attributable profit RMB16.63bn (~NT$81.7bn) times an assumed ~84% Hon Hai stake gives ~NT$68.6bn. Add the rest-of-group residual, which I estimated at roughly NT$8-11bn per quarter in H1 2026 and ~NT$20.6bn in Q3 2025, taking ~NT$8-15bn for Q3 since the TWD was flat (31.852, -0.04% QoQ) and the Q2 FX loss is unlikely to recur. That gives ~NT$77-84bn, close to the margin model (3.03tn revenue, 3.6-3.8% operating margin, ~25% tax, ~14% NCI -> 72-84) and the 72-86 local analyst range. Downside: AI-rack margin dilution (FII shares fell 7% on its results), valuation losses, higher NCI. No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.

calls.reference_class: Hon Hai quarterly parent net profit vs. a sum-of-parts estimate from FII results plus the rest-of-group residual (2025-2026 quarters); analyst EPS model ranges

calls.reasoning: Revenue is known (NT$3,026.9bn). FII Q3 attributable profit RMB16.63bn at a Q3-appropriate ~4.5-4.6 TWD/RMB is ~NT$75-77bn; at 84% that is ~NT$62-65bn to Hon Hai. Add a rest-of-group residual of ~NT$11-20bn (Q1/Q2 2026 ~10bn with near-zero non-op; Q3 2025 ~21bn with +16bn non-op; FX flat in Q3 2026). That gives ~73-85bn, consistent with a margin model (OM 3.6-3.8%, tax 25%, NCI 12-14bn -> 73-82) and the local analyst range of 72-86. Median 78.5.
calls.reconciliation: The main dispute was factual: the TWD/RMB rate used to translate FII's RMB16.63bn. Runs 2/3 relied on a press conversion (~NT$81.5bn, implied ~4.9) that likely used late-October spot rates after the TWD weakened toward 33. Q3-period rates (USD/TWD ~31.85, USD/CNY ~6.9-7.1) give ~4.5-4.6, so Hon Hai's 84% share is ~NT$62-65bn, not 68-69. I could not verify this with web access, so I widened the distribution slightly. Re-deriving each period's residual on a consistent FX basis gives ~10bn (Q1/Q2 2026) and ~21bn (Q3 2025). The Q3 2026 residual is a judgment call: with flat FX, Q2's FX loss probably did not repeat, so I put it at 11-20bn. The operating margin is also a judgment call: Run 2's 3.8-4.0% looks optimistic given AI-rack dilution and FII's post-results share drop. I reuse Run 1's dispersion of 16. Market check: none found on Polymarket/Manifold (harness); I could not check Kalshi or bookmakers on this run.

All runs assume it; consistent with known holdings; treated as approximately correct.
